title: OSKA plan
description: The typed, ordered operations produced for one procedure, plus the inputs it still needs.

procedure_id.description: The procedure this plan belongs to. Named `runbook_id` in the reference implementation.

operations.description: Operations to run, in order. Every entry must be declared by an integration in the procedure's hydrated closure.

missing.description: Inputs the plan cannot supply. Each carries the question to ask the user.

reply_intent.description: Short instruction for the reply writer. Adds no facts.

integration_id.description: The integration that declares this operation.

payload.description: Arguments, validated against the operation's input schema before execution.

write.description: Must match the declaration; a mismatch invalidates the plan.

purpose.description: Why this operation is in the plan, for the audit trail and the approval summary.

field.description: The payload field the answer fills.

question.description: The question to ask, in the user's language.
